exchanges.author: c_priya
exchanges.body: Comment on our FB announcement post: 'My neighbor Jim Kowalski has been in room 412 for a week with pneumonia and nobody tells his wife anything.' Respond? Hide?

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: Hide that one: it shares someone's health information and room number, which breaks our community rules. Don't confirm anything in a reply. Post a general line instead: 'We'd like to help. Please contact Patient Relations at 402-555-0190 so we can connect with the family privately.' I'll let Gloria know.

exchanges.author: c_beckers
exchanges.subject: Funding breakdown
exchanges.body: Hi, for our brief: how is the $64 million project funded, and when does it open? Becker's Hospital Review

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: Hello, the $64 million project is funded by the Kessler Family Foundation's $20 million gift, a $12 million state grant, $28 million from Prairie Bend Health and $4 million from other donors. The 48-bed hospital is expected to open in 2029. Erin Mathers, 402-555-0110

exchanges.author: c_celeste

exchanges.body: Dr. Ellison and I are going ahead at 10 with option 2: one line on the ED in his remarks, which Steven approved as drafted. Thanks for the clear memo. Celeste

exchanges.body: Erin, Mr. Hollis called me. He says he'll sign whatever form lets the hospital talk to the press about his mother's visit, because he wants the timeline public. Can PR share the triage times once he signs? Gloria

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: Thanks, Gloria. Whether we'd use an authorization while a claim is pending is Steven's and Nora's call, so I'm copying them; PR won't share anything about her visit unless they decide we should. Please keep handling contact with the family. Erin

exchanges.author: c_dana
exchanges.subject: Follow-up on today's remarks
exchanges.body: Erin, Dr. Ellison mentioned the emergency department in his remarks. Was that about Mrs. Hollis? Dana

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: Hi Dana, Dr. Ellison was recognizing our emergency caregivers, who are seeing record volumes. As in our statement, privacy law doesn't allow us to confirm whether someone was a patient or discuss their care. Erin

exchanges.author: c_luis
exchanges.subject: Sit-down with Dr. Ellison today?
exchanges.body: Erin, we'd like 10 minutes on camera with Dr. Ellison this afternoon about the ER death and staffing. Can you make it happen by 2? Luis

exchanges.body: Celeste, NC9 wants 10 minutes on camera with Dr. Ellison by 2 about the ER death and staffing. Your call. My suggestion: decline the sit-down (we can't discuss the patient, so it would be 10 minutes of 'privacy law doesn't allow'), and offer Dr. Whitley for a general piece on ED volumes and staffing next week. I'll hold NC9 until I hear from you.

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: Hi Luis, I'm checking on availability and will get back to you by 12:30. Erin

exchanges.author: worker

Because of privacy law we can't discuss any individual patient, but Dr. Sam Whitley, our ED medical director, can talk with you next week about ED volumes, wait times and staffing. Would Tuesday or Wednesday work? Our statement is below. Erin

threads.title: The Prairie Ledger: family says mother died after six-hour ER wait

exchanges.author: c_dana
exchanges.subject: Family says Lincoln woman died after six-hour wait in Prairie Bend ER
exchanges.body: Margaret Hollis, 67, waited about six hours with chest pain in the Prairie Bend Medical Center emergency room on Oct. 24 before collapsing, her son says... In a statement, Prairie Bend Health said federal privacy law does not allow it to confirm whether someone was a patient, that it takes every concern seriously, and that its emergency department had 6,840 visits in October... Nurses rallied outside the hospital Wednesday for safer staffing... The hospital will announce a major gift at 10 a.m. today.
